acceptance: Every section 1 fix in this PR's scope is done, each with a test: role checks on the five inventory reads (OWNER/ADMIN/STAFF) and the seven purchasing reads (OWNER/ADMIN), updateApplianceStatus refusing RETIRED in plain and bulk changes while retireAppliance still works, purchaseReceiptTotalCents in the domain (unit-tested), getPartsList returning a staff DTO whose price/cost keys are absent (asserted absent, not hidden), the low-stock rule in SQL matching getLowStockParts

Fleet: status tabs with counts from one groupBy, search by appliance number prefix / serial exact / model contains, cursor (createdAt desc, id desc) with same-instant units appearing once each across pages, bulk Change status offering only statuses at least one selected unit can move to, built-in views registered for the fleet list

Appliance record: header, stat strip, pure applianceNextStep, status-based primary action, Retire behind a danger confirmation with a required reason, tabs; staff keep the operational Overview only; custody form uses the kit SearchablePicker over domain search (no getCustomers preload); the record's independent reads run in one Promise.all

Retired page restyled with FILTERS tabs and counts, bulk Mark done with confirmation; the page's local follow-up-days setting block is REMOVED (drift: AR-8 already shipped the Settings row retiredFollowUpDays with writer setRetiredFollowUpDays)

Purchases, Parts and Suppliers PAGES are split into AR-6b per the card's ~1,500-line rule (six pages plus eight domain fixes cannot stay reviewable in one PR); their section 1 domain fixes land here so AR-6b is pages over ready reads
ci green at the exact head; every review comment read
invariants: No inventory rule changes beyond spec section 1: every button calls an existing server action; transitions still come from ALLOWED_APPLIANCE_TRANSITIONS
Roles are enforced at the query/DTO boundary: requireRole inside the read functions themselves (layouts do not re-run on navigation), and staff part DTOs omit the money keys entirely
Money stays integer cents through existing helpers; the receipt total is computed in the domain, never in a page
Retiring always goes through retireAppliance with its reason and retired plan; the plain and bulk status changes can never reach RETIRED
Accountant access approved by ACCT-1 stays exactly as it is; this card adds no role and widens none
next: AR-6b — Purchases and orders pages, Parts page, Suppliers (spec sections 5-7) over the role-checked reads this PR lands
outcome: Equipment's domain reads are role-checked and bounded, the fleet list and appliance record run on the kit with cursor paging, and the retired page is restyled — with Purchases/Parts/Suppliers pages split to AR-6b under the card's size rule
